author: Kushal
problem: Read an H1 x W1 matrix A and an H2 x W2 matrix B. Print Yes if B can be obtained by deleting some rows and some columns of A, otherwise No.
bug_description: after.append(after_row) sits outside the kept-row check, so a deleted row still adds the previous row again to the reduced matrix.

comments.accurate: Tries every choice of kept rows and columns and checks whether the reduced A equals B
comments.wrong_behavior: Tries every choice of kept rows and columns, carrying the last kept row forward in place of a deleted one
comments.wrong_location: Row assembly verified; check that the column bitmask indexes columns from the left
